_comment: Tier-2 for the three fix surf/temp claims in one deck. Ten variants run on the installed binary. cht:0 — the intuitive order (surf_collide before the fix) and a MISSING fix produce the SAME message, 'ERROR: Surf_collide tsurf could not find custom attribute (../surf_collide.cpp:141)', which is the entry's point: the diagnostic cannot tell you which mistake you made. cht:1 — a bare compute source, which is what the SPARTA doc page's own example passes, aborts with 'ERROR: Fix surf/temp compute does not compute per-surf vector (../fix_surf_temp.cpp:82)', and 'c_q[*]' aborts identically because the wildcard parses as index 0; 'c_q[1]' runs; a single-value fix ave/surf over-indexed as f_aq[1] gives 'ERROR: Fix surf/temp fix does not compute per-surf array (../fix_surf_temp.cpp:112)'. cht:2 — emissivity 0.0 and 1.5 both give 'ERROR: Fix surf/temp emissivity must be > 0.0 and <= 1 (../fix_surf_temp.cpp:125)' while 1.0 exactly is accepted. Every quoted message matched verbatim including the (file:line) suffix. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 with SPARTA (24 Sep 2025).
